title: Large Typography FAQ
description: High-contrast design with massive 3XL typography for key product questions and direct concise answers.
heading: High-Impact Product FAQ
subtitle: Oversized typography engineered for rapid readability.

questions.question: What hydrostatic head water-resistance rating does the fabric achieve?
questions.answer: Tested to 10,000mm hydrostatic head pressure, offering complete protection against continuous heavy downpours.

questions.question: Does the garment require re-proofing treatment over time?
questions.answer: We recommend applying a spray-on DWR re-proofer after every 15 to 20 washes to maintain maximum water repellency.

questions.question: What seam tape width is applied to stress points?
questions.answer: 22mm thermo-sealed polyurethane tape is applied across all primary seam junctions.
